logMetrics.name: aresweb_app_check_rejected
logMetrics.description: Mutation requests with missing, invalid, or unexpected-app App Check observations.
logMetrics.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" textPayload:"[app-check] App Check observation" (textPayload:"\"status\":\"missing\"" OR textPayload:"\"status\":\"invalid\"")

logMetrics.name: aresweb_access_denied
logMetrics.description: API requests rejected by authentication or authorization without retaining identity values.

logMetrics.name: aresweb_rate_limited
logMetrics.description: Shared or local request quotas returning an HTTP 429 response.

logMetrics.name: aresweb_server_error
logMetrics.description: Handled API failures returning an HTTP 5xx response.

logMetrics.name: aresweb_ai_generation
logMetrics.description: Successful AI provider invocations without prompts, content, or user identifiers.

alertPolicies.name: ARESWEB App Check rejection surge
alertPolicies.containment: Inspect canonical-origin and app-version health before changing enforcement.

alertPolicies.name: ARESWEB authorization denial surge
alertPolicies.containment: Check token failures and targeted route groups; do not log or enumerate identities.

alertPolicies.name: ARESWEB shared quota surge
alertPolicies.containment: Preserve evidence, keep quotas enabled, and isolate only the affected feature if cost grows.

alertPolicies.name: ARESWEB API server-error surge
alertPolicies.containment: Identify the current revision and route group; roll back only when the release is causal.

alertPolicies.name: ARESWEB AI generation volume
alertPolicies.containment: Review daily quota state and disable only system_settings/ai_generation when usage is unexpected.

platformAlerts.signal: Cloud Run request count and 5xx ratio
platformAlerts.action: Alert when the 5xx ratio exceeds 5% with at least 20 requests.

platformAlerts.signal: Cloud Run instance and billable-instance time
platformAlerts.action: Alert when a service sustains 80% of its configured maximum-instance ceiling.

platformAlerts.signal: Cloud Firestore document reads and writes
platformAlerts.action: Alert on a 3x increase over the trailing seven-day same-hour baseline.

platformAlerts.signal: Vertex AI request and token usage
platformAlerts.action: Alert before the project daily token budget reaches 75%; the application quota remains the hard guard.

budget.note: Billing budgets notify but do not stop spend. Use feature-level circuit breakers rather than disabling project billing.
